decisions.statement: The module taking a value away is called rather than reached through a rung.
A property with many values keeps its key when the last value goes.
A property with one value goes with that value.
Whether a property is required is read from the page type the page is.
A required property is refused rather than taken away.
Taking a required property away is a retype.
A property that could not be read as required or not is refused.
A value the property does not have is refused rather than taken away.
The body is answered rather than written.
The passage answered is the lines the value is taken out of rather than the body.
The only text written here is the empty string.
No page is taken away here.

definition: one value taken out of one page property in a page's body
